name: Tencent Hunyuan (yuanbao.tencent.com)
siteVersion: Next.js shell per repo inventory (hunyuan-yuanbao CAPABILITIES.md, JS-bundle analysis 2026-09-15); exact build pins to be recorded on first live capture
description: Capability package for Tencent's Hunyuan AI assistant web app. The consumer chat product is Tencent Yuanbao at https://yuanbao.tencent.com/ (chat console). Everything is tool-call content streamed over ONE endpoint POST /api/chat/; this package sends prompts through the yuanbao composer and reads streamed tool-call answers off the page.
author: ui2api capabilities

transport.chat: single SSE-over-XHR endpoint POST /api/chat/ (vendored custom SSE client, NOT EventSource) — all chat/tool-call modes ride this one stream; control via site JS, no over-the-wire reconstruction needed for the UI paths
transport.chunkShape: custom_sse parses event:/data: lines; server replies `event: message, data: <json>`; capability/modality is encoded in content[].type (text, step, continue_step, page, middle_message(s), reasoner/deep_think_box chain-of-thought, toolCall, yuanqi_tool_call, doc_percent, docDeepModeInfo, deepSearch, deep_search CoT, searchGuid, progress, news, card, error, voice_recorder), not in endpoint variation
transport.authMechanism: hy_user/hy_token are domain session cookies managed by Tencent login (oneid/oauth) and asserted by the API server via the Cookie header; every browser request uses credentials 'include' / withCredentials, plus X-ID (userId) + X-Token (session token) headers; browser JS never writes these cookies directly
transport.antiBot: X-webdriver: 1 when navigator.webdriver is true -> headless/automated Chrome is flagged; Turing.js risk-control loader + QIMEI fingerprint SDK; expects a real logged-in session. HEADED + real profile required.
transport.modelSelection: GET /api/models and /api/agent/model/list; each model can carry internetSearch; URL param modelId= is honoured; fast-think/deep-think switch (modelType fastThink/deepThink); search-mode scenes ai_search_light / ai_search_pro / ai_search_deepseek
transport.toVerify: request bodies were not executed during bundle analysis; exact wire verified on first live capture

capabilities.name: Chat
capabilities.description: Send a prompt on the Yuanbao composer (Quill contenteditable, .ql-editor candidate); site's own JS posts to POST /api/chat/ and streams tool-call content (text, step, reasoner/deep_think_box CoT, toolCall, search cards). Method: ui-path (trusted input + Enter, site's own send handler).
capabilities.method: ui-path (trusted input + Enter, site's own send handler)

capabilities.name: Deep search (AI-search report)
capabilities.description: Deep-search session: chat scene ai_search_pro (finance ai_search_pro_fin, DeepSeek ai_search_deepseek); session provisioning via GET /api/inputguide/search/create; CoT streams as deep_search content chunks with step/process + per-step waits and searchGuid cards; tools google_web_search/paper_search/hunyuan_web_search render as deep-search CoT cards. UI trigger (AI-search entry / 联网-deep mode on the composer) is a candidate — verify selector on first live capture.
capabilities.method: ui-path (search-mode toggle on composer + chat prompt)

capabilities.name: Conversation history list
capabilities.description: List/detail: GET /api/convs, /api/conv (+ /api/user/agent/conversation/list, /api/user/agent/conversation/v1/detail, /api/user/agent/session/list); rename/pin/clear/delete via /api/conv/title, /api/user/agent/conversation/*. Endpoints verified from bundles; DOM-sidebar fallback until live-verified on first capture.
capabilities.method: wire (real cookies + X-ID/X-Token headers), DOM-sidebar fallback

capabilities.name: Knowledge-base / document Q&A
capabilities.description: Attach one document per turn (types per uploaderTypeList: pdf/doc/docx/ppt/pptx/xls/xlsx/txt/csv); wire = /api/resource/genUploadInfo -> COS write -> /api/resource/fileParse|asyncFileParse -> doc analysis rides the same /api/chat SSE stream as doc_percent/docDeepModeInfo/step chunks (deep-read modes TRANSLATION/SUMMARY/GUIDE/DEEP_SEARCH; mind-map GET /api/user/agent/doc/getMindMap).

capabilities.name: Voice mode
capabilities.description: Voice input via mic on the composer; ASR/TTS temp key GET /api/generate/voice_tmpkey; voice_recorder content chunks with SPEAKING/STOPPING/SPLIT statuses. Thin and chat-coupled; to be validated on a live session.
capabilities.method: ui-path (mic button — exact trigger to be verified on first live capture)
